about: Hand-written scene layout: where people can walk, which area belongs to which place, the named spots (api-contract 0 'spot'), where each place starts (startSpots: where a player whose role starts in that place stands; characters take that place's free spots in layout order, except way.* and spots marked auto: false, which only an explicit placement uses; the player's spot counts as taken, characters with group: true take none) and the exits. Plan coordinates in metres as in build_plaza.py: +x towards the castle, +y towards the temple, the gate street runs to -x (azimuth 294°). pack_scene.mjs rotates by rotationDeg about the up axis and writes glTF coordinates into scene.json. Spots where people leave for another scene are named way.<slug> (the exit. prefix belongs to the world model's ExitId).

walkable.name: plaza, gate street, castle steps, temple porch

places.about: the walled yard south-west of the fountain; the gate in its north wall is the way in

the forecourt of the castle with the scaffold and post, and the end of the gate-to-post corridor in front of it, where the crowd stands facing the post with its back to the gate (S-050: the same square becomes the execution ground); the corners are cut so the fountain and plaza-east stay in the square

exits.about: the castle door at the top of the steps

plaza-southwest.about: first screen: south-west corner looking at the castle

way.road-to-city.about: outside the gate; people leaving fade out here

market-west.about: in front of the west stall

market-east.about: in front of the east stall

old-man-house.about: in front of the old man's door (building S2), facing the square

old-man-house-side.about: beside the old man at his door, facing him: where the player stands after walking him home (aff.walk-old-man-home playerSpot)

temple-porch.about: between the front columns and the temple door

workshop-gate.about: outside the yard gate, still in the square

workshop-door.about: at the stonemason's house door in the yard (obj.workshop-door, 戸を叩く), the bench on the left

stake.about: on the platform with the back to the post, facing the square: the one tied to the post and hoisted up

scaffold.about: on the platform beside the post, close enough to reach the hoisted one's feet

stake-front.about: in front of the platform steps: where the player lands at the execution ground (startSpots, the slice's act-1 exits); auto: false so no one is placed there before the player arrives

stake-front-side.about: beside stake-front, facing the platform: the old man stands here next to a player at stake-front (slice, 'stay at the old man's house')

crowd-front.about: front row of the crowd, by the north-west corner of the platform, facing the post: the maiden with the scarlet cloak, close enough to hand it to Melos on the platform

ground-west.about: west end of the execution ground, facing the gate down the light corridor: where a player who stayed in the city to wait for Melos sees him come through the gate at sunset (ux/slice/ending-shots.md, shot 2). 2.5 m south of the gate-to-post line, so the follow camera behind the player clears the post and the platform (UX, PR #32). auto: false: only the act plan puts someone here

ground-south.about: south of the platform, facing the post: where someone the act plan does not place stands to watch. Listed before castle-steps so the first one stands by the post, not up the steps; 7 m off the gate-to-post corridor and out of both default follow shots from ground-west (portrait 48°, landscape 63° off the view axis; UX on PR #51)

king-west.about: west end of the execution ground, behind the crowd, facing the post: where the king first stands at sunset; north of the gate-to-post line, about 4.6 m from ground-west on the other side, so a player there does not block him

way.castle.about: at the castle door; people going in fade out here
